newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Schenectady, N.Y.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
City of Schenectady
New York
Public Improvement Serial Bonds, Series 1997
(the
Sealed bids for the above-captioned bonds will be
received by the City of Sch enectady, New York (the
City''), at the offices of Squire, Sanders & Dempsey,
L.L.P., 350 Park Avenue, 15th Floor, New York, New York
10022 until 11:00 A.M., Prevailing Time, on
January 28, 1997,
at which time and place the bids will be opened for the
purchase at not less than par and accrued interest of
$10,530,000 aggregate principal amount City of
Schenectady, New York, Public Improvement Serial Bonds,
Series 1997, dated February 1, 1997, bearing interest
payable semi-annually on February 1 and August 1 commencing
February 1, 1998, and maturing on February 1 in the years
and corresponding principal amounts as follows:
Principal Principal Principal
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
Such bids will be opened in public at said time and place
on said day for the purchase of the Bonds. The Bonds will be
subject to redemption as specified in the Notice of Sale.
The Bonds will be awarded pursuant to the method set forth
in the Notice of Sale. The Bonds are general obligations of
the City and will be secured by the full faith and credit of
the City, all as more fully described in the Preliminary
Official Statement. The approving opinion of Squire, Sanders
& Dempsey L.L.P., Bond Counsel, will be furnished to the
successful bidder at the expense of the City.
Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement and the
Notice of Sale and the Proposal Form relating to the Bonds
may be obtained from the Financial Advisor to the City,
Munistat Services, Inc., 12 Roosevelt Avenue, Port Jefferson
Station, New York 11776 (516-331-8888). Each bid must be
submitted on a bid form (not a photocopy thereof) contained
in the Notice of Sale and Proposal Form. The Bonds will be
delivered on or about February 12, 1997.
City of Schenectady, New York
Laura L. Hardy
Director of Finance
Dated: January 23, 1997
(From The Bond Buyer)
